_about: Where the Twin Dial fonts (package A1) come from. Only the files listed here; the older faces in this folder carry their own licence file. Both are SIL Open Font License 1.1, no Reserved Font Name; the files here are cut-down copies (glyph subset, narrower axis ranges), made by tools/twin-dial/a1/subset_fonts.py from the downloaded originals.

Saira[wdth,wght].ttf.cut: Basic Latin, Latin-1, Latin Extended-A/B, punctuation, arrows; wght 400-700, wdth 100-125 (Saira draws digits and our Latin labels only)

NotoSans-wght.subset.ttf.cut: Latin, Cyrillic block, General Punctuation, the number sign, the minus, and tools/bake_fonts.py CAR_TEXT; wdth pinned at 100, wght 400-600
